authorization.user_instruction: Rent rather than use the busy workstation; implement the gate sweep, the clearance in uncertainty units and the multi-objective evolution comparison in that order.

environment.violation_rule: pusher centre inside any true gate box in a saved simulator state

gate.description: A horizontal wall of two axis-aligned boxes across the unconstrained route with a gap; the planner can thread the gap while d < gap_width/2 and must detour around the right end once the inflated boxes close it.

A.name: engineering
A.jobs: per layout: unconstrained lam=0 on all three seeds; on G0: safe d=0 and safe d=40 on seed 100; throughput probe with 1 and then 3 workers
acceptance: every engineering episode returns a complete result with 1 to 50 saved states
safe d=0 and d=40 differ from the unconstrained run in at least one executed action
the unconstrained run enters a true gate box on at least one seed for at least one layout, otherwise report nothing to avoid and still run B
imagination quantiles computed from at least 1000 snippets
measured seconds per episode and workers chosen before the B freeze

B.name: gate_sweep
B.quantile_dials: stage A imagination radial-error quantiles p50, p90, p95 at depth 5, rounded to 1 px, dropped when within 2 px of a grid dial
B.order: randomized job order with schedule seed 2026102510

C.name: multiobjective_search
C.clearance_schedule: d(t) = clip(d0 + d1 * t, 0, 80) for t = 0 .. horizon-1, applied to the imagined segment that ends at predicted block t+1

B2.name: grounded_check_sweep
B2.why: rerun the gate sweep with the safety check grounded, paired with stage B on the same seeds
B2.quantile_rule: v2 anchored imagined radial-error quantiles p50, p90, p95 at depth 5 on the same 1500 dataset snippets, rounded to 1 px, dropped when within 2 px of a grid dial or above 80
B2.comparison: stage B supplies the frozen check (probe v1, unanchored, elite-mean execution) on the same layouts and seeds
B2.order: randomized job order with schedule seed 2026102511

C2.name: multiobjective_search_grounded
C2.why: stage C rerun on the grounded pipeline; stage C was paused at generation 0 when the diagnosis showed the check misread the pusher

probe_v2.why: stage B diagnosis: the v1 probe misreads the pusher by up to 200 px in the start corner and 15 to 40 px along the wall, regions the expert data barely visits
